metadata.title: Conformome pilot release v0.1.0: conformational-state evidence records for proteins and nucleic acids
metadata.description:
Data release of Conformome (https://conformome.org), an index of experimental and computational evidence on the conformational states of proteins, RNA and DNA. The pilot covers 87 molecules: 81 proteins, five RNAs (the Vibrio vulnificus adenine riboswitch aptamer, the preQ1-I riboswitch aptamer, HIV-1 TAR, the Tetrahymena group I intron P4-P6 domain and the SARS-CoV-2 frameshift stimulation element) and one DNA (the human telomeric G-quadruplex). The corpus holds 17,677 evidence entries from ten ingested sources (RCSB PDB, BMRB, SASBDB, DisProt, AlphaFold DB, MDDB, SMASH-BIO, NAKB, Rfam and RMDB; RNAcentral supplies RNA identifiers), of which 15,089 are archived here; the 2,588 SMASH-BIO force-spectroscopy entries are linked at source because their data licence is not stated. 36 molecules carry draft curation with 83 conformational states (15 for nucleic acids). Contains all archived molecule, state, transition, evidence and model records (all-records.jsonl), one JSON bundle per molecule, 64 per-nucleotide reactivity profiles from RMDB, the JSON Schemas, the technique taxonomy, the per-molecule curation files (states, curator assignments and mapping rules), the manifest of raw inputs with URLs, retrieval dates and SHA-256 checksums, and EXCLUDED.tsv listing what was left out and why. See README.md for file descriptions, identifier schemes and source attributions.

Generated by the Conformome pipeline, version 0.1.0 (software DOI: see related identifiers).
